verdict.description: INTERCAMBIABLES: same pattern. NO_INTERCAMBIABLES: distinct patterns. INSUFICIENTES_INCIDENTES: fewer than 2 incidents to compare.

rationale.description: Detailed reasoning: essences extracted from each incident, comparison, and justification of the verdict.

essence_1.description: Essence of incident 1: behavioral pattern abstracted from its specific context.

essence_3.description: Essence of incident 3. Empty string if no third incident was provided.

suggested_action.description: Only if NO_INTERCAMBIABLES. mantener: category is correct. dividir: create separate categories. refinar: broaden definition to encompass variation. Empty string if INTERCAMBIABLES.

suggested_action_detail.description: Detail of the suggested action: what to split, how to refine, or why to keep. Empty string if not applicable.
